gaps.where: Add-ons → every card (In this business, Available to add, Coming soon, Vote on what’s next), each keyed by its add-on
gaps.gap: get_settings (area add_ons) returns no addonId anywhere: inThisBusiness is {name,state,running}, availableToAdd is {name,summary}, comingSoon/mostVotes/youVotedFor are names. Yet manage_add_on’s description and update_addon_settings’ not-found error both point to get_settings (area add_ons) for the id, and manage_add_on, update_addon_settings, read_addon_settings, read_addon_connection_list, do_addon_vote and do_addon_unvote all take one. Some indirect routes exist: the prompt’s directory gives “Name (id_…)” for running add-ons only, find_capabilities gives addonId on at most two suggestions (only when nothing here meets the need) and on up to eight planned matches (includePlanned), and capability ids are prefixed with the add-on id. None of these covers a turned-off, uninstalled, available-to-add or testing add-on as listed on the page, or a most-voted planned one, so the model must guess and gets “HandsFreeOS has no add-on by that name.”
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_settings (area add_ons) gives each add-on’s addonId: In this business, Available to add, Coming soon, the most-voted and what the business voted for. read_addon_roadmap gives it on every planned add-on.

gaps.where: Ideas → an idea → What happened (each status change with the team’s note, who and when, the merged idea’s title, the What’s new entry)
gaps.gap: find_ideas(ideaId) returns story: updates.map(ideaUpdateLine), which only says “Moved to Not planned”, “Shipped” or “Merged into #n”. It leaves out each update’s note (the team’s words in the highlighted box), who it was by, the date, the other idea’s title and the What’s new entry’s title. idea.get returns all of them. So the Assistant can’t answer “why is my idea not planned?” or “what did the team say?”.
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas’ story gives each update as What happened says it: the line, who made it, the day, the team’s note in their words, the other idea’s number and title, and the What’s new entry.

gaps.where: Add-ons → a card’s state detail, Testing badge, the note in place of Install (“A paid add-on. HandsFreeOS support can turn it on for you.”, “It needs X, which can’t be added here.”), and the trouble callout (“Not quite finished…” with each failed check); Available to add including add-ons handed to the business to test
gaps.gap: The add_ons shape keeps only name, state and running for installed add-ons. It drops summary, retired, the testing badge and the trouble callout (lastError and failedChecks). availableToAdd filters on c.status === 'available', so add-ons handed to the business to test (c.testing), which the page offers, are left out. Available add-ons carry no offer note, so a paid or blocked one looks installable. The Assistant would offer to install it and be refused, while the page says “A paid add-on. HandsFreeOS support can turn it on for you.”. It can’t answer “why is my add-on stuck?”.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_settings (area add_ons) says each card in the page’s words: what its state means, paused or retired, the Testing badge, the trouble callout with each failed check, and the note in place of Install. Available to add includes add-ons handed to the business to test, with canInstall.

gaps.where: Add-ons → an add-on’s What it lets you do / What it needs / Works with (with why) and its longer description; phone: an add-on’s own screen, Does, Needs, Works with
gaps.gap: No Assistant read returns an add-on’s What it needs or Works with (manifest.requires, with the reason for each), or its longer description. find_capabilities gives label and description only for features already here, restricted or turned off. Suggestions (at most two) and planned matches carry capability labels only, with no descriptions. A paid, blocked, testing or uninstalled add-on’s capabilities are never described. What moves with a change appears only on manage_add_on’s confirm card, which is a proposal, not a read.
gaps.fix: Fixed: each add-on in get_settings (area add_ons) carries its category, longer description, What it lets you do, What it needs and Works with, each with why, from its manifest.

gaps.where: Add-ons → Vote on what’s next: search, category chips with counts, Group, Sort (Most votes, A to Z), each card’s votes, summary, tags and “Already in HandsFreeOS:” overlap; Coming soon with summary and “Your business voted for this.”
gaps.gap: Finding a planned add-on by words does work: find_capabilities({need, includePlanned: true}) ranks planned add-ons by name, summary, keywords and capability labels, and returns up to 8 with addonId, name, summary and does. What is missing: votes, voted, category, groups and overlap on those matches; any way to list a category or get a named add-on’s vote count unless it is in the top 5; and Coming soon is names only, with no summary or “Your business voted for this”, and isn’t filtered against installed add-ons as the page does.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_addon_roadmap reads Vote on what’s next as the page filters it: search, category chips with counts, groups, Sort (votes or A to Z), each add-on’s votes, category, groups and Already in HandsFreeOS, and Coming soon with Your business voted for this, without the add-ons the business has. get_settings’ Coming soon gives summary and youVoted, filtered the same way.

gaps.where: Ideas → an idea → Comments → Delete (on your own comment)
gaps.gap: do_idea_set_comment_hidden is offered (input {commentId, hidden}), but find_ideas maps comments to {by, on, words} with no id and no sign that a comment is the person’s own, so the Assistant can never take down the person’s comment. The screen shows Delete on your own comments. This is a takedown (hidden), offered on purpose, so it isn’t covered by the never-delete-for-good rule.
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas gives each comment its commentId and who wrote it (You for the person’s own), so do_idea_set_comment_hidden can take down their own.

gaps.where: Ideas → an idea → Edit your idea (Your idea, in a few words / Tell us more / What is it about?, pre-filled)
gaps.gap: do_idea_edit (IdeaEditInput) needs title, body and areaId together, and body defaults to '', so leaving it out wipes the details. The single-idea read from find_ideas joins title and body into one `words` string and returns no areaId and no canEdit. Partly mitigated: list rows carry area: i.areaId; the title can’t contain a blank line, so the words can be split; and idea.edit refuses when the person may no longer edit. Fixing a title still risks wiping the details or moving the idea to another area, and the Assistant can’t tell up front whether editing is still open.
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas’ one idea gives title, details and areaId apart, as do_idea_edit takes them back, plus the area’s name and canEdit.

gaps.where: Ideas board → Area filter (Every part of HandsFreeOS / an area (n)), Show more ideas, and each row’s comment count and “Name · 3 days ago”
gaps.gap: find_ideas has no areaId or cursor input, though idea.list takes both and the board filters by area and has Show more. It defaults to 10 and caps at 20, reports count: ideas.length and drops nextCursor, so a list that was cut short looks complete. Rows leave out commentCount, the author’s name and the date it was shared, all of which the board shows.
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas takes areaId and cursor, says more and nextCursor when the page was cut, and each row carries its comment count, who shared it and the day.

gaps.where: Ideas → an idea’s address, the business-free link the emails use (/app/ideas/<id>), and the board’s filter addresses meant to be sent
gaps.gap: No screen shows or copies a link to an idea. The business-free /app/ideas/<id> link appears only in emails, and the address bar shows the same /app/w/<ws>/ideas/<id> path the Assistant’s card gives. The real part: find_ideas and manage_idea return only a path, and the prompt never gets the web app’s address, so when someone asks for a link to send, the Assistant can give a path or a guessed domain but not a full https link that works for someone in another business.
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas and manage_idea’s share answer give link, the business-free /app/ideas/<id> address on the web app’s own address, which opens the idea for anyone on HandsFreeOS.

gaps.where: Any refusal about an add-on that points to “Settings → Add-ons” (Add-ons is its own place at the foot of the side menu; phone: More → Add-ons)
gaps.gap: Add-ons is no longer a Settings page: it sits at the foot of the side menu, and the old URL only redirects. Many refusals the Assistant relays, and some it writes itself, still send people to “Settings → Add-ons”, a tab that isn’t in the Settings menu.
gaps.fix: Fixed: every refusal that said Settings → Add-ons now says Add-ons, at the bottom of the side menu (done in the Sales Coach step).

gaps.where: An add-on’s Connections (core’s /addons/<id>/connections, or the add-on’s own tab such as Real Estate’s settings?tab=connections): Sign in with …, Sign in again, Connect…, Use your own account…, Paste a new key → Try it and save, Switch back to HandsFreeOS’s account
gaps.gap: read_addon_connection_list tells the Assistant which services an add-on connects to, how (key, oauth or platform), the field labels and hints, and whether the person may manage them. do_addon_connection_disconnect exists. Nothing tells it where the Connections page is or what to press. Signing in and pasting a key go through the worker’s /v1/addons/connections/* routes, not commands, so they appear in no NEVER list and no handover. The add_ons area has only the delete-data handover, and the prompt’s settings_help list names Google, Outlook, Stripe and Square but not add-on connections. Signing in stays with the person (settled), but the Assistant can’t give the steps or the screen.
gaps.fix: Fixed: settings-map’s add_ons handovers include connecting an add-on with a sign-in or a key, with the steps and where (the add-on’s Connections, or the link read_addon_connection_list now gives as page). read_addon_connection_list’s description says signing in and keys are the person’s own, a key never goes in the chat and nobody can read one back. settings_help and the prompt name it.

gaps.where: Add-ons → Turn off / Uninstall → confirm dialog: consequence (“anything it had scheduled is cancelled”) and What it holds here (“12 records stay…”, “3 things it had scheduled are cancelled.”, “It lets go of 2 things it holds outside HandsFreeOS.”)
gaps.gap: manage_add_on’s Impact type and card ignore addon.impact’s holds and kept. The turn_off note leaves out that anything it had scheduled is cancelled. The screen’s confirm dialog shows ADDON_MOVE_WORDS.disable.consequence and addonHoldsLines: the records kept, “3 things it had scheduled are cancelled.”, and “It lets go of n things it holds outside HandsFreeOS.”. So the person agrees on the Assistant’s card having been warned less than the dialog would warn them.
gaps.fix: Fixed: manage_add_on’s card uses the page’s own consequence words for Turn off and Uninstall, and adds What it holds here (addonHoldsLines from addon.impact’s holds): the records kept, what it had scheduled that is cancelled, and what it lets go of outside HandsFreeOS.

gaps.where: Add-ons → Vote on what’s next → Upvote (one vote per business)
gaps.gap: SAY.planned tells the model “Owners and admins vote for what comes next on Add-ons”, pointing the person to do it themselves, and add_ons.canChange doesn’t list voting. do_addon_vote and do_addon_unvote are offered to the same people (addons.manage), and addon.vote’s own description is clear, so the tool is still visible. The Assistant’s words point away from it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: add_ons.canChange lists voting for a planned add-on or taking the vote back, and SAY.planned tells the model it can cast or take back the business’s vote (do_addon_vote, do_addon_unvote) and read the vote with read_addon_roadmap.

gaps.where: Ideas → an idea → Comments (n), each commenter’s name, and “Shared by <name>”
gaps.gap: find_ideas keeps only the last 10 visible comments (.slice(-10)) and doesn’t say how many there are or that some were left out. Every commenter who isn’t the team or the person becomes “Someone”, though the screen shows their name. The idea’s author name is dropped (only sharedByYou).
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas gives commentCount and, when only the last 10 are shown, how many earlier ones there are. Each commenter and the author are named as the page names them (You, their name, or Someone, with the team’s badge).

gaps.where: Ideas → an idea: “The HandsFreeOS team took this idea off the board. Only you can see it.”, “In What’s new: <title> · <day>”, the merged-into title, its area, and Where it stands (status meaning)
gaps.gap: mergedInto returns id and number, so its title is one more find_ideas call away, and the story says “Shipped” when a What’s new entry delivered it. Still missing from find_ideas’ idea: hidden (“The HandsFreeOS team took this idea off the board. Only you can see it.”), shipped (which What’s new entries and when), the area’s name and the date it was shared. So the Assistant can’t explain why the person’s idea vanished from the board, or name the update that shipped it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas’ one idea says when the team took it off the board (in IDEAS_WORDS.hidden), which What’s new entries shipped it and when, the merged idea’s title, the area’s name and the day it was shared.

gaps.where: Phone → More (Add-ons row for owners and admins, with each add-on’s moves and Switches); web side menu foot (Add-ons and Ideas above Get help, never arranged or hidden)
gaps.gap: PHONE_APP’s More line leaves out Add-ons, which owners and admins have on the phone (and also Documents and the add-ons’ own places). EVERY_PAGE’s “Bottom of the side menu” leaves out Add-ons and Ideas, which sit there above Get help and can’t be arranged or hidden. The “Only on the web: … the business’s settings” line isn’t wrong, since Add-ons isn’t a Settings page, so dropping add-ons from it isn’t needed. It should instead say Add-ons works on the phone.
gaps.fix: Fixed: places-map’s side menu line names Add-ons and Ideas at the bottom, never moved or hidden. The phone’s More line already named Add-ons.

gaps.where: Ideas → an idea → Edit your idea, and Delete on your own comment
gaps.gap: The Ideas place’s canChange lists find, share, vote, comment and follow. It doesn’t list editing your own idea until the team answers it (do_idea_edit) or deleting your own comment (do_idea_set_comment_hidden). onScreen leaves out Delete on your own comments, so the Assistant may say it can’t do either.
gaps.fix: Fixed: the Ideas place lists editing your own idea until the team answers it and deleting your own comment, and its screen lines name Delete on your own comments and Edit your idea.

gaps.where: Ideas → Roadmap: Planned, In progress, Done lately (up to 100 a column)
gaps.gap: read_idea_roadmap returns the raw columns. Past 16,000 characters (about 80 cards) it is cut from the end, so Done lately goes first, and the cut note asks for a smaller page though idea.roadmap takes no input. Its description says “shipped lately”, not the last 90 days. Partly mitigated: find_ideas with status planned, in_progress or done reads each column by votes or trending, though only up to 20 and with no 90-day bound for done.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_idea_roadmap gives Planned, In progress and Done lately (the last 90 days, newest first), each with what it means, its count and its first 15 cards with area names; column reads up to 60 of one, and find_ideas with a status pages through the rest. Done lately is never the part cut for length.
